Drop the frame columns a sample's design does not need

Source: R/state.R
compact_sample.Rd

A weighted sample holds its own copy of the whole frame, every column of it, so that ht_total(), ht_mean(), as_svydesign() and sample_summary() can work from the sample alone. That copy is kept in memory and written to every file the sample is saved to, which costs as much as the frame each time, and hands the frame, with any names, addresses or other personal data in it, to whoever receives the file. compact_sample() replaces the copy with one that holds only the columns the design reads (strata, clusters, size measures, order_by, time stamps, coordinates and the like) and the columns named in keep.

Usage

compact_sample(sample, keep = NULL)

Arguments

sample

A data frame returned by draw() with weights = TRUE, or by as_drawn().

keep

Names of other columns of the frame to keep, such as the by columns of the estimates.

Value

sample, with a smaller copy of the frame.

Details

Estimates, standard errors, as_svydesign() and sample_summary() are unchanged, with two exceptions that read other frame columns. A by domain's size in the frame, which ht_mean(estimator = "ht") with by divides by, needs the by columns in the stored frame; without them that estimator is refused with a message naming keep. And a stratum with a single sampled row leaves a domain's variance unmeasured unless the stored frame's by columns show the stratum holds none of the domain (see "Domains" in ht_total()). Keep the by columns of the estimates in keep, and the columns frame_totals() is asked for. Whether a column of the frame left out holds only 0 and 1, which makes ht_mean() treat it as a proportion, is recorded.

The sample's own columns are not changed: drop columns of the sample with s$col <- NULL. The inclusion probabilities of every frame row are kept, one number per row.

See also

draw(), as_drawn()

Examples

pop <- data.frame(id = 1:5000, site = rep(c("a", "b"), each = 2500),
                  note = strrep("x", 40), spend = (1:5000) %% 97)
s <- draw(pop, design_stratified("site", n = 100), seed = 1, weights = TRUE)
small <- compact_sample(s)

# The same estimate from a fraction of the bytes
c(full = length(serialize(s, NULL)),
  compact = length(serialize(small, NULL)))
#>    full compact 
#>  395577   95655 
all.equal(ht_total(s, "spend")$se, ht_total(small, "spend")$se)
#> [1] TRUE
